Hope you had a good weekend. We're in the middle of Helios Health's procurement review and our security team has a couple of asks before we can clear Redwood for production. We received Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report that ends 2026-09-30 — thanks for sharing.

Two outstanding items our InfoSec reviewer flagged:
1) A short bridge/endorsement letter (or confirmation) that covers the period from 2026-10-01 to the present, acknowledging there have been no material control changes impacting the SOC 2 scope, or — if there have been changes — a short mitigation summary.
2) Evidence that key management practices are still in force for production data: specifically KMS key rotation records and proof of customer-key separation for at-rest encryption (or a statement describing homogenous vs. tenant-isolated keys).

If you can provide a draft bridge letter and the KMS rotation export (or a redacted sample) that would suffice for our audit desk. We need this by Friday 2026-12-10 to stay on track.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if easier.
